name: OG Ron C
sources: style-research-extended vol.1 crunk — OG Ron C (the `houston-screw` lane's research section)
notes: ⛔ **A producer entry, and its whole identity is one axis: chop-forward rather than pitch-forward.** The research says so in those words, and names the chop density as "the parameter that separates him from Watts" — so this model is deliberately authored as the Watts entry with the two ends swapped. Chop up, transpose down less. ⛔ **The pitch/chop balance is the research's OWN INFERENCE, and the entry is rated medium for exactly that.** "His variant emphasises less pitch drop ... so transposition is smaller (roughly 1–2 semitones) while chop density rises" is followed by "the pitch-versus-chop balance is characterised as inference". So the two-semitone register drop below — melody 50–79, chords 38–70, bass 18–37, 808 12–26, each two under the genre's floor rather than Watts's three — is inference resting on inference and is the first thing to revisit if this lane is ever re-researched. Sourced hard: his role, the Chopstars founding in 2001, the ChopNotSlop name, the 58–70 output band, the technique family, the boosted low end, the unaltered-and-re-ordered source material, and full-album chop editions with DJ drops and blends. ▶ **The highest chop-event density anywhere in this dataset, and it is the point.** `snare.clusterProb` 0.55 with 2–4 hits is the stutter-repeat on snare and clap hits; `kick.beatSkipProb` 0.36 is the beat skip; both are the top of their range in the lane, above the genre's own chopnotslop mode and far above Watts. The `reverse` lane leads `percs` at 1–3 per bar with `placement` `any` and only −4 dB of trim, because a re-trigger placed anywhere in the bar is what a chop is and it is not a background layer here. ▶ **Doubled phrase re-triggers are the counter, at a sixteenth.** `echoOffset` `1/16` against Watts's quarter note: a chop-forward double lands almost on top of the phrase it repeats, where a screw-forward one lags a whole beat behind. `timbreHint` is `chopped_vocal` — the name of his own variant, and the genre's chopnotslop mode already uses it. ▶ **Short, re-ordered fragments.** `phraseBars` gives real weight to 1 and 2 bars, `motifPitchCount` falls to 2–4, and `octaveJumpProb` rises to 0.1 — fragments reconfigured out of order jump where a written line would step. `emptyBarBias` stays low at 0.12 because chop density fills the bar rather than emptying it, which is the opposite of what the rest of this lane does. ⛔ **`bass808.monoCutSelf` stays `true`, against both other producer entries here.** Screw and Watts get a sub whose decay overlaps the next hit; a chop-forward record re-triggers, and a re-trigger cuts. The research's "less extreme pitch shift" keeps the 808 two semitones down rather than three. The bass rhythm is `mirror_kick` at 0.94, because a held-note rhythm emits one note per chord and saturates. ⚠ **DJ drops over section changes are `switchUpProb` 0.20**, the highest in this batch, and blends between records are the long structures with a 12–24 bar verse. ⚠ **The two moving chord families are the source records' own harmony, retained rather than invented**; they carry the low weights so the chord part clears its distinctness floor and the bass has more than one root. ⚠ **Fill fingerprint.** `gapProb` 0.16 / `descendProb` 0.36 / `rampJitter` 25 over 8th-triplets, even grouping — the most jittered roll in the band by a clear margin, which is a hand-cut chop rather than a programmed one. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,1,4], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
